owner_request: 2026-08-26 conversation: after collecting 9,000 additional 15-minute six-MA launch candidates, Owner asked to move the displayed line three bars earlier, recover the previous small detection-window and small signal-box logic, avoid a fixed box position, collect safe negatives and train on the RTX 3060. Repository Gold Dataset gates forbid treating candidate ranking or a uniform line shift as sample labels. This preregistration therefore freezes an Owner review surface that records an exact per-sample category and geometry while generating no training image, YOLO label, negative, model or remote training job.
question: Can every one of the 9,000 new candidates be reviewed against one explicit Local Signal V2 geometry schema without converting the t-3 display marker or completed future path into an automatic label?
single_variable: Review representation only: replace an unlabeled PENDING candidate card with a fail-closed Owner category plus per-sample W14-22 / core4-7 / confirmation3-5 geometry receipt; candidate membership, ranking and pixels stay unchanged.

protocol.marker_semantics: The blue t-3 line is a review reference only. It is neither a class verdict nor a box boundary and it supplies no default geometry answer.
protocol.drop_or_uncertain_geometry: All geometry fields must be null. A rejected proposal is not automatically a safe negative, and an uncertain proposal enters neither class.
protocol.position_contract: Owner selects input length, core width and confirmation delay per sample. No batch shift, fixed center, fixed right edge, geometry quota or automatic box placement is allowed.

position_degeneracy_audit_after_complete.action_on_failure: Keep training_eligible=false and return to Owner review; never jitter or rebalance geometry mechanically.

direction_contract.SHORT: Owner protocol direction is frozen, but each KEEP and its geometry still require this per-sample review and a later explicit dataset release.
direction_contract.LONG: mirror_unconfirmed: a LONG KEEP may preserve an Owner sample observation, but it remains excluded from positive and negative training roles until Owner separately approves the mirror protocol.

downstream_gates.owner_export: A complete JSON export must contain exactly one identity-bound decision for every source event. KEEP requires exact valid geometry; DROP and UNCERTAIN forbid geometry.
downstream_gates.summary: The committed summarizer may produce an eligibility preview, but every output row remains training_eligible=false and production_eligible=false.
downstream_gates.gold_dataset: Only after the Owner returns the export and explicitly releases the audited SHORT KEEP set may a separate preregistered builder materialize short training images and labels.
downstream_gates.negatives: Only after accepted positive exclusion zones exist: collect same-symbol and same-time-block isolated easy and hard negatives, preserve full Owner-box exclusion, time split with purge, and treat the previous 3:1 train negative ratio as a soft target rather than permission to weaken exclusions.
downstream_gates.training: No RTX 3060 training until category, geometry, direction, split, negative and byte-level dataset gates pass. Training completion will stop at artifacts; no promote, ACTIVE change, deployment or trading.

controls.economic_metrics: Not applicable: this is an annotation-surface integrity task with no model, entry, exit, cost, return or score.
controls.null_control: A synthetic export test must reject unknown IDs, duplicated IDs, identity drift, incomplete default exports, invalid W/core/delay arithmetic and geometry attached to DROP or UNCERTAIN.
